'''Honest Blim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] and sold used [[Droid/Legends|droids]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Blim owned and operated [[Procopia Preowned Automata]] during this time.<ref name="NEG" />
